We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Our Fleet Management team builds the platform that connects Wayve’s engineers and operators with a global fleet of autonomous vehicles and data-collection devices. From software deployment and vehicle health to robotaxi operations, our services give teams the visibility and control they need to operate confidently as the fleet grows.

You’ll join an early-stage team working across web applications, backend services, embedded APIs and cloud infrastructure. With multiple OEM integrations and vehicle configurations to support, you’ll help shape both the systems we build and the engineering practices behind them.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Own meaningful projects from problem definition through design, implementation, deployment and production operation.

- Partner with Product, Research, Safety, Operations, SRE and Infrastructure to turn complex fleet needs into reliable services and intuitive tools.

- Contribute to architecture and planning, and validate ideas through prototypes.

- Write well-tested code and review changes with your peers.

- Make technical trade-offs that improve fleet visibility, reduce friction for users and keep systems dependable as deployments scale.

- Support other engineers’ growth through feedback and shared technical learning.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Reliable deployment workflows for software, AI models and configuration across vehicles that may be intermittently connected, including correctness, ordering and rollback.

- Services connecting Wayve vehicles with external dispatch systems to support robotaxi and remote autonomous operations.

- APIs and web interfaces that make vehicle state visible and help engineers diagnose issues quickly and confidently.

- Tools for exploring vehicle telemetry and operational data, alongside reporting on utilization, performance and mission outcomes.

- Scalable, observable full-stack systems whose quality, maintainability and evolution you own in production.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You have experience building, shipping and operating production full-stack applications and web services.

- You bring hands-on depth across frontend, backend and infrastructure. Our stack includes React, TypeScript and MUI; Rust, Go and Node.js; and Kubernetes, Azure and Bazel. Experience with it is a plus, not a requirement.

- You have independently owned projects from an ambiguous problem through technical design, delivery and ongoing operation.

- You understand API contracts, data modeling, service boundaries and the reliability, consistency, scalability and failure modes of distributed systems.

- You use metrics, logs and traces to understand production behavior and guide decisions.

- You communicate clearly across engineering, product and operational teams, and enjoy mentoring and improving engineering practices.

- Experience with robotics, autonomy, robotaxi operations, telemetry pipelines, OTA deployment, remote device management or multi-OEM environments would be valuable, but is not essential.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. title: Middle HR People Partner | Honeytech
description:
Hi!

We are Boosta , a holding tech company that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

We are currently looking for a Middle HR People Partner to join our product IT company Honeytech, which creates digital entertainment products and develops its own webcomic and anime platforms for a global audience.

• 100+ professionals on the team

• 3x growth over the past year

• 22M+ users worldwide use our product

Honeytech is a dynamic, fast-growing project that has already become #1 in its niche! Imagine Netflix, but for comics - in just a few years, we’ve gathered over 15 million users, challenged giants from South Korea, and proven that it’s possible to build a world-class product from Ukraine.
As a Middle HR People Partner, your challenges will include:

• Support the Employee Lifecycle: onboarding, adaptation, one-to-ones, Performance Reviews, Salary Reviews, PDPs, offboarding, and exit processes.

• Help new employees adapt quickly and advise teams on HR processes and company policies.

• Coordinate corporate benefits, including HoneyFit, HoneyMeal, gifts, coworking spaces, relocation, and other support programs.

• Own the Learning direction: organize internal training, collaborate with speakers, and develop EduSpace and the corporate library.

• Participate in the development and automation of HR processes and the launch of new HR initiatives.

• For candidates based in Kyiv - help with office operations and supplies.

We are looking for a specialist who :

• Has 3+ years of experience as an HR People Partner, HR Generalist, HR Manager, or in a related role.

• Has experience working with teams of 50+ employees.

• Has hands-on experience conducting Performance Reviews and One-to-Ones, as well as developing PDPs.

• Has experience supporting onboarding and offboarding processes.

• Has experience working with HRM systems.

• Has experience administering corporate benefits.

• Has experience implementing or owning HR projects, including launching new processes, automation, and developing HR functions.

• Has confident Google Workspace skills.

• Has a B1 level of English or higher.

• Is based in Warsaw, Wrocław, or Kyiv.

• Is self-motivated, proactive, responsible, and systematic in their approach to work.

Your journey with us:

•
Stage 1. Intro call with a recruiter.

•
Stage 2. Interview with the project's HR Manager.

•
Stage 3. Test task.

•
Stage 4. Final interview based on your test task.

• After that, our recruiter collects references from your previous employers, and you receive your Job Offer 🚀

What do we offer?
Self-realization & growth

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and professional self-realization together with the company.

• Work on an exciting, non-standard project with the ability to build processes from scratch and experiment.

• A strong team of motivated professionals who are always ready to support and help.

• Work with the most competitive markets: Tier-1, LatAm, and Europe.

• Diverse learning opportunities: expert talks, a large corporate library, compensation for external courses, and, of course, English lessons + speaking clubs.

Comfortable working conditions

• Remote work or the option to work from our office in Kyiv, as well as coworking spaces in Lviv and Warsaw.

• Flexible schedule and the ability to plan your own working day.

• 20 working days of paid vacation per year (after 3 months of cooperation) + 30 days of sick leave.

Care & support

• Corporate trips, regular team-building, and gifts.
